# Well Pump Reference Library

> Free, ad-free, cross-brand comparison charts of residential and light-agricultural well pumps and pressure systems: submersible pumps, jet pumps, constant-pressure systems, pressure tanks and controls (308 rows), plus a sizing guide, FAQ and a side-by-side compare tool.

Specs come from official manufacturer pages and catalog PDFs; every row links its sources, and pump curves are linked rather than reproduced. Price rule: Price = lowest in-stock price for a new unit of that exact model seen on a public US retailer or manufacturer-store listing (seller named and linked), checked on the date shown. No affiliate links. If no live price was found, a $ band is shown as an editorial estimate. Editorial bands: $ under $250 · $$ $250–$600 · $$$ $600–$1,200 · $$$$ $1,200–$2,500 · $$$$$ over $2,500. Data last checked Nov 15, 2026 and refreshed monthly. No ads, no affiliate links. Made by Marcus Travis. This is a reference, not installation advice; confirm sizing and wiring with a licensed well or pump installer and an electrician.

## Catalogs

- [Submersible pumps](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/submersible): Compare residential and light-ag submersible well pumps across brands: HP, voltage and phase, flow at head, shutoff head, minimum well size, warranty and price, with links to official pump curves. (101 rows)
- [Jet pumps](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/jet): Compare shallow-well, deep-well, and convertible jet pumps across brands: HP, voltage, flow at head, warranty and price, with links to official data sheets. (58 rows)
- [Constant-pressure systems](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/constant-pressure): Compare constant-pressure well water systems — variable-speed drives and matched pumps from Grundfos, Franklin, Goulds, Pentair and others — by HP, voltage, flow, pressure and price. (30 rows)
- [Pressure tanks](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/tanks): Compare well pressure tanks by total volume, drawdown at a stated pressure setting, maximum pressure, warranty and price, with links to official data sheets. (66 rows)
- [Controls: switches, control boxes, VFDs](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/controls): Compare well pump controls: pressure switches, 3-wire control boxes, pump protection devices, and standalone variable-frequency drives, by rating, setting, warranty and price. (53 rows)

## Guides and tools

- [Well pump FAQ](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/faq): sizing, submersible vs jet, shallow vs deep jets, constant pressure, tank size, precharge, 30/50 vs 40/60, 2-wire vs 3-wire, 115 V vs 230 V, cost
- [Sizing basics](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/sizing): gpm, total dynamic head with a worked example, tank drawdown, shallow vs deep wells
- [Compare](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/compare): up to four items side by side
- [Updates](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/updates): monthly changelog

## Optional

- [Full text for LLMs](https://wellpumpchart.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): every FAQ answer and every catalog row in plain text
